doc: A moving part of a building: where it turns or moves from, and how (design/systems.md, Village houses). Bones come after their parents.

fields.name: pivot
fields.doc: Where it turns, metres, in the model's rest frame.

fields.name: axis
fields.doc: A unit axis: what it spins or hinges about; for sway, the way the part hangs or streams; for rise, up.

fields.name: motion
fields.doc: fixed (the root), sway (bends in the wind: a sign, a banner, laundry, an awning, the tent), spin (a wheel, sails, a weathervane), rise (a smoke puff rising, swelling, and fading, on a loop), hinge (the door, by door_time), flicker (a glow or flame pulsing).

fields.name: rate
fields.doc: Spin: turns per second (sails and vanes turn faster with the wind); rise: loops per second; sway: its natural frequency, Hz; flicker: Hz.

fields.name: reach
fields.doc: Hinge: the open angle, radians; rise: how high a puff goes, metres; flicker: how much it pulses (0 to 1); sway: the most it bends, radians.

fields.name: drag
fields.doc: How much the wind moves it (0: not at all).

fields.name: phase
fields.doc: Where in its loop it starts, 0 to 1, so neighbours don't move together.
